text_en: I thought I was going to die in there._300_ I don't know how to thank you._300_ I'm getting out of here as soon as I can catch my breath.
I was just about to break these webs, but thank you anyway._300_ I hope the others can be saved too.
Thank you._300_ We expected to find spiders in this cave,_100_ but not this size!_300_ <color=CHA>Makerel</color> and <color=CHA>Gruper</color> must be desperate if they were caught too.
You?_300_ Thank the Gods!_100_ I thought that spider was coming back for me.
Thank you for saving me._300_ We weren't prepared for this. I don't even know how you managed to survive this far._100_ We better get out of this cave as soon as possible.
Urgh..._100_ Was it you who got me out of there? Sorry if I'm not exactly celebrating, but what does it matter if we're still here?
